crossReference.title: LibreDWG MATERIAL object schema
crossReference.use: Peer schema corroborates DWG scalar widths only; its self_illumination field maps to DXF 149 while Autodesk's current DXF table lists 90. This disagreement remains unresolved and is not used to type either field.

typedModel: DRW_Material retains refraction index/map fields with documented defaults and individual presence flags.
Group-9 filename retention has an independent bounded text lease; the 16-value transform has independent cardinality state.
Copy/reset behavior preserves authored values and restores defaults/identity with presence false.
parser: Later group 273 is left opaque as Final Gather Mode and cannot overwrite the typed refraction source.
Validates finite scalar/matrix values, documented source/projection/tiling/auto-transform domains, and exactly 16 contiguous matrix values.
writer: Emits refraction groups in documented order, with all 16 group-147 values when the transform is present.
Rejects invalid authored domains and non-finite refraction values before output replacement.
boundedTextRegression: The focused MATERIAL retained-owner CTest checks exact-cap group-9 filename replacement in ASCII and Binary DXF.
At one byte under the cap, the previous refraction filename remains intact while earlier replacements remain admitted; copy/reset accounting releases the retained lease correctly.

generatedControls: Generated ASCII/Binary MATERIAL records carry all five map families with distinct values and a following LINE sentinel.
Group 273 appears once as refraction source before the boundary and again after 465 as an opaque context-specific value; tests verify raw order and unchanged typed source.
Tests assert same-/cross-encoding replay, copy/reset/defaults, matrix endpoints, and valid source-zero typed-writer output.
Invalid domains, temporary ASCII non-finite scalar/matrix values, and 15-/17-value matrices are rejected before callback publication.
Typed writer tests assert schema order and transactional refusal/retry for invalid domains and non-finite authored values.
No persistent drawing fixture is added; malformed non-finite values are applied only to locally generated temporary ASCII inputs.
